data.label: Text statistics function
data.description: Takes {text} and returns the word count (words separated by whitespace) and the Unicode code-point character count to the caller. It owns its least-privilege execution role, a scoped CloudWatch log group, a published version and a live alias. It has no public URL.

brief.application: Build a small AWS application that accepts a synthetic text document through an authenticated invocation and returns its word count and character count. Use serverless compute, a least-privilege execution identity and operational logs. No model or public anonymous endpoint is needed. Use AWS for this synthetic qualification design. Propose Sydney as a candidate region, but do not record that as an approved deployment region. Draw the architecture and identify the next missing decision. This is a test design, not an instruction to deploy.

decisions.subject: design.first-sketch-authenticated-word-character-count-on-aws-lambda
decisions.title: First sketch: authenticated word/character count on AWS Lambda
decisions.context: Scope: an existing IAM caller invokes AWS Lambda directly using IAM authentication (lambda-invoke). There is no HTTP API and no anonymous endpoint. The Lambda function returns the word and character counts. The generated execution role, CloudWatch log group, published version and live alias belong to the function. Assumptions: the proposed defaults are 64 KiB input, 128 MiB memory, 10-second timeout, concurrency 1 and 30-day log retention, and all of them can be reviewed. Sydney (ap-southeast-2) is a candidate region only. It is not approved, and regional availability has not been verified. The design uses synthetic test data only. This is not a deployment.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.

needs.statement: Proposed: given {text}, the service returns a word count (whitespace-delimited) and a Unicode code-point character count.

needs.statement: Proposed: only explicitly authorised IAM principals can invoke the function. There is no public or anonymous endpoint.
needs.rationale: Prevents unauthenticated use and keeps the attack surface minimal.

needs.statement: Proposed: the function writes operational logs to a scoped log group, with a retention period that still needs confirming (30-day default proposed).
needs.rationale: Supports troubleshooting while limiting how long log data is kept.
